verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs describe a REST API, a CLI, an MCP server, llms.txt and typed schemas, but no official language SDKs or client libraries. Those surfaces are adjacent to the story, not the SDKs it asks for, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no published spec to generate clients from either. For an API platform this axis applies, so the lack of evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
